summary: Crash when changing render distance / java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 28084 out of bounds for length 26136
description: When changing render/view distance via the option menu while standing inside a world, minecraft sometimes crashes with an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. This can be best reproduced by spam-clicking the slider in random positions, although for me it crashed after only one click, the first time.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Enter the Options menu and navigate to Video Settings.
4. Move the Render Distance slider to any position by spam-clicking it in random positions.
5. Observe that Minecraft crashes with an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
6. Alternatively, try changing the render distance once and observe if the crash occurs after a single click.
Observed Behavior: When changing the render distance via the option menu while standing inside a world, Minecraft sometimes crashes with an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`. This issue occurs when the index 28084 is out of bounds for a length of 26136. The crash can be best reproduced by rapidly clicking the slider in random positions within the options menu. However, it has also been observed to occur after just one click on the first attempt. This behavior suggests that the problem may arise due to improper handling of array indices when adjusting render distance settings dynamically while in a world.
Expected Behavior: When changing the render distance via the option menu while standing inside a world, Minecraft should not crash and should adjust the view distance smoothly without any exceptions. The game should handle multiple rapid changes to the slider without issues, ensuring stable performance and no unexpected errors or crashes.
